title: Crispy Vietnamese Noodle Salad
description: A refreshing and crunchy vegan noodle salad inspired by Vietnamese flavors.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and marinate in a mixture of peanut oil, salt, and chili flakes for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu until crispy and golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, crispy tofu, cucumber, carrots, and mint leaves.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Vietnamese dressing ingredients (see below) and pour over the noodle mixture. Toss to coat.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional mint leaves if desired.
